title: Isomorphic daisy cubes based on their $τ$-graphs
summary: We prove that if $A$ and $B$ are daisy cubes whose $τ$-graphs are forests, then $A$ and $B$ are isomorphic if and only if their $τ$-graphs are isomorphic. The result is applied to show that a daisy cube with at least one edge is the resonance graph of a plane bipartite graph $G$ if and only if its $τ$-graph is a forest which is isomorphic to the inner dual of the subgraph of $G$ obtained by removing all forbidden edges. As a consequence, some well known properties of Fibonacci cubes and Lucas cubes are provided as examples with different proofs.
